record_scope_reconstruction: Syrian armed roadblocks blocked access to Bab al-Hawa–Cilvegözü for aid and commercial trucks; planned Turkish maintenance is separate.

source_checks.finding: OCHA-derived account explicitly reports 19–25 July inaccessibility from Syrian roadblocks and sand barriers; trucks could not collect aid despite a planned humanitarian lane.
